Revocation one-way (reason/actor/epoch); revoked SID cannot be re-signed or transferred; revoked key cannot attest and existing credentials verify as issuer_revoked. Transfer = owner request + owner acceptance signed by a target-trusted key; installations/model selections/role-template version move atomically (deferred FKs) while identity hash + old credential stay verifiable. Recovery = re-sign the same hash with a still-trusted key (full lost-key ceremony not implemented; stated in docs).
